crossRefs.note: Yahweh will cause you to be struck before your enemies. You will go out one way against them, and will flee seven ways…
You will father sons and daughters, but they will not be yours, for they will go into captivity.
‘Yahweh says, “You shall not go up, nor fight against your brothers! Every man return to his house; for this thing is…
“The day following, he appeared to them as they fought, and urged them to be at peace again, saying, ‘Sirs, you are…
Brothers, children of the stock of Abraham, and those among you who fear God, the word of this salvation is sent out to…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Samaria
people.line: Capital city of the northern kingdom of Israel; Samaritan inhabitants

translations.web: The children of Israel carried away captive of their brothers two hundred thousand women, sons, and daughters, and also took away much plunder from them, and brought the plunder to Samaria.
translations.bsb: Then the Israelites took 200,000 captives from their kinsmen—women, sons, and daughters. They also carried off a great deal of plunder and brought it to Samaria.
translations.kjv: And the children of Israel carried away captive of their brethren two hundred thousand, women, sons, and daughters, and took also away much spoil from them, and brought the spoil to Samaria.
translations.asv: And the children of Israel carried away captive of their brethren two hundred thousand, women, sons, and daughters, and took also away much spoil from them, and brought the spoil to Samaria.
